notes: Adds a unified Safety Actions dashboard for Managers/Admins. It combines controlled-document approvals/reviews, overdue training, PPE issues and overdue checks, First Aid replenishment/checks, custom checklist actions, PTW approval/overdue/close-out actions and overdue Monthly Knowledge Checks. Actions are prioritised red/high or amber/action-required, show owner/due/status, can be filtered/searched, and each row has a direct Go there button. A Safety Actions shortcut is also shown on My Safety for Managers/Admins and Help gains a direct Safety Actions entry. Includes all v2.10.38 role-aware Help and v2.10.37 flicker fixes. No SQL migration required.
